name: Tuskcode Shop the Look
author: dan009

sections.description:
Tuskcode Shop the Look lets you integrate multiple products in the single one. The descriptive image of the main product will let you choose which product to add to cart.

Features
* Set product as shop the look
* Select 4 linked products
* Mark main product as non-purchasable

Requirements
* Woocommerce v5.0 or later
* WordPress v6.2 or later recommended

Frequently Asked Question

= Where is the settings page =
There is no settings page except the Product->Shop to look tab.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the unzipped folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress admin section
  3. Go to any simple product and in the tabbed section select ‘Shop the Look’ tab
  4. Mark the product as Shop the Look product and select the linked products
